# Claude Code Model Gateway

> A configuration and verification kit for using exact Claude, Codex, GLM, and Grok model routes through CLIProxyAPI in Claude Code without hiding fallback or context-window limitations.

The human-edited source of truth is `models.yaml`. Generated agents, settings,
and profiles must match it. Never invent model IDs, provider availability,
context sizes, credentials, or successful live results. Local setup is macOS
first, binds CLIProxyAPI to loopback, and requires the human to complete browser
OAuth. Run deterministic checks before inference tests.

## Setup

- [Agent setup contract](https://github.com/acartag7/claude-code-model-gateway/blob/main/docs/agent-setup.md): Exact zero-context workflow, hard safety rules, success criteria, failure handling, and completion report.
- [Complete macOS setup](https://github.com/acartag7/claude-code-model-gateway/blob/main/docs/setup.md): Human walkthrough for local and remote gateways, provider login, isolated-profile testing, live verification, and rollback.
- [Human overview](https://github.com/acartag7/claude-code-model-gateway/blob/main/README.md): Problem, outcome, quick start, supported catalog, honest limits, and security boundary.

## Configuration

- [Model catalog](https://github.com/acartag7/claude-code-model-gateway/blob/main/models.yaml): The only hand-edited source for model IDs, context evidence, effort, roles, fallback, and generated agents.
- [CLIProxyAPI baseline](https://github.com/acartag7/claude-code-model-gateway/blob/main/config/cliproxy.example.yaml): Loopback-only, bearer-authenticated starting configuration with remote management, request cloaking, and cross-model quota substitution disabled.
- [Environment template](https://github.com/acartag7/claude-code-model-gateway/blob/main/.env.example): Names of required gateway variables and optional Cloudflare Access service-token variables; contains no values.

## Behavior and limits

- [Custom models and subagents](https://github.com/acartag7/claude-code-model-gateway/blob/main/docs/custom-models.md): Exact routing, model-picker limitations, subagent override behavior, and explicit fallback rules.
- [Context windows](https://github.com/acartag7/claude-code-model-gateway/blob/main/docs/context-windows.md): Difference between upstream capacity and Claude Code's client budget, safe mode, and unsupported full-context experiments.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/acartag7/claude-code-model-gateway/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Credential handling, network exposure, and private vulnerability reporting.

## Optional

- [Claude Code gateway protocol](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol): Upstream protocol reference.
- [Claude Code model configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config): Upstream model selection and environment behavior.
- [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI): Gateway implementation used by the reference setup.
